extraction.disclaimer_span: We do not offer every plan available in your area. Currently we represent 26 organizations which offer 3,740 products in your area. Please contact Medicare.gov or 1-800-MEDICARE to get information on all of your options.
extraction.benefits_span: The Aetna plan available in Lee County has a $10 monthly premium, a $20 drug deductible and a $5900 maximum out-of-pocket.
extraction.soa_span: I've sent the Scope of Appointment to your email so we can go over specific plans. Can you sign it while we're on the line?

composition.summary: The agent discussed Medicare Advantage plans with the customer, who prioritized keeping her doctors. The agent scheduled a follow-up call for 6 hours later to review specific plans.
composition.coaching_note: The agent asked the customer about her priorities, but then immediately started discussing benefits without waiting for the customer to sign the Scope of Appointment. To improve, the agent could wait for the customer to sign the SOA before discussing benefits.
